## Summary
- Tested on the game hotfix from **2026-09-22** (Steam buildid **25444214**).
- Rebuild required: the hotfix replaced the base pak; older RU font packs do not match this build.
- No new strings (lobby / map loading / cutscene hotfix). ST + UI + fonts rebuilt from current game assets.
- World textures overlay kept (bulk sizes still match).
- Unsupported; source is free to use.

## Install
Download the zip → run `Install.bat` → launch via Steam.

If you had **v0.1.19** (or older) installed: run `Uninstall.bat` (or delete `StormEscape-Windows.pak.bak_ru`), then Steam **Verify integrity of game files**, then `Install.bat`. The old `.bak_ru` is from a previous game build.

## Uninstall
`Uninstall.bat`
